The '''''Recusant''-class light destroyer''',<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> also known as the '''''Recusant''-class Commerce Guild destroyer''',<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> '''''Recusant''-class warship''', or '''Commerce Guild warship''',<ref name="Tarkin">[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]</ref> was a model of [[destroyer]]<ref name="Grievous Intrigue Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/grievous-intrigue-trivia-gallery|text="Grievous Intrigue" Trivia Gallery}}</ref> manufactured by [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]] for use by the [[Commerce Guild]], and later, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|Separatist naval]] commanders such as [[General]] [[Grievous]] often employed ''Recusant''-class starships as their [[flagship]]. They saw extensive service in numerous battles of the Clone Wars, such as [[Battle of Saleucami|Saleucami]], [[Battle of Kamino|Kamino]], and [[Battle of Coruscant|Coruscant]]. Despite being slower and less maneuverable than similar Republic vessels, they continued to see service with the Separatist navy as late as the [[Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="Episode III" />

The true effectiveness of the ship was shown when it was deployed in large numbers. Four to six ''Recusant''-class starships could outgun the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] or the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]]. However, about one thousand ''Recusant''-class ships were needed to take on the [[Mandator II-class Star Dreadnought|''Mandator-II'' Star Dreadnaught]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Recusant''-class light destroyer was a model of [[destroyer]]<ref name="Grievous Intrigue Trivia" /> manufactured by the [[Quarren]]-based [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]]<ref name="Collapse" /> for usage by the [[Commerce Guild]]<ref name="Grievous Intrigue Concepts" /> and later the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|naval forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Episode III" /> and was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]] generator.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> The Recusant was also equipped with a [[docking tube]], and was armed with [[laser cannon]]s,<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> that provided enough firepower to larger numbers of four to six craft to outgun the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] or the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]]. However, a total of one thousand ''Recusant''-class ships possessed enough firepower to outgun the [[Mandator II-class Star Dreadnought|''Mandator-II'' Star Dreadnaught]].<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> The vessel had two variants of different sizes; the larger was capable of ferrying at least one [[C-9979 landing craft]] on its outer [[hull]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

==Role==
Within the Confederacy navy, the ''Recusant''-class light destroyer served as the [[command ship]] of naval commanders, but was also used as a support ship. Controlled by a [[droid brain]], the Recusant was slow on its reaction time, and gained a reputation for colliding with friendly ships as a result.<ref name="BMF 75" />

==History==
===Assorted deployments===
The ''Recusant''-class light destroyer was produced in great numbers by the [[Commerce Guild]] and,<ref name="Heart of the Swarm">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2021/1/25/heart-of-the-swarm|text=Heart of the Swarm}}</ref> in [[time]] for the beginning of the [[Clone Wars]] waged between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and [[Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2020" /> added to the ranks of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|CIS Navy]]. Reinforcing that navy's daunting ranks,<ref name="Heart of the Swarm">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2021/1/25/heart-of-the-swarm|text=Heart of the Swarm}}</ref> countless Recusants would be built, destroyed, and replaced over the course of the war, with new numbers of the craft always being constructed by zealous [[Techno Union]] workers, who were granted materials from Commerce Guild worlds and overseen in the mass-production effort by Union foremen. The ship was most clearly effective when fielded in large numbers, but single Recuscants were often seen raiding the Republic's commercial shipping network.<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2020" /> Furthermore, a single Recuscant could also take the command ship role in a fleet.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

At one point during the ship model's service to the CIS, the ''Recusant''-class ship ''[[Nova Defiant]]''—which was not painted in<ref name="Nova Defiant">{{Armada|set=Recusant-class Destroyer Expansion Pack|cardname=''Nova Defiant''}}</ref> the standard blue of the CIS like other Rescusants<ref name="Episode III" />—took part in a battle over a green astronomical object.<ref name="Nova Defiant" /> The Recusant ''[[Gilded Aegis]]'' was once deployed over an [[Waterworld|aquatic astronomical body]] alongside a number of [[Trident-class assault ship|''Trident''-class assault ships]].<ref name="Gilded Aegis">{{Armada|set=Recusant-class Destroyer Expansion Pack|cardname=''Gilded Aegis''}}</ref> A [[Recusant-class Support Destroyer|''Recusant''-class Support Destroyer]] once sat in [[orbit]] over a green celestial body, where it was stationed alongside two [[automated vulture droid deployment station]]s.<ref name="Support Destroyer">{{Armada|set=Recusant-class Destroyer Expansion Pack|cardname=''Recusant''-class Support Destroyer}}</ref>

===Capturing Eeth Koth===
[[File:Capture_of_Eeth_Koth.png|thumb|left|270px|Grievous's ''Recusant''-class light destroyer prepares to dock with the ''Steadfast''.]]
In [[21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Landing at Point Rain]]" to [[21 BBY]], and {{HelmetCollectionCite|76|Highlights of the Saga}} dates the [[death]] of [[Ponds]], as seen in the episode "[[Lethal Trackdown]]," to the same [[Standard year|year]]. Since {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}} places "[[Grievous Intrigue]]" between "Landing at Point Rain" and "Lethal Trackdown," its events must take place in the same year.</ref> [[Kaleesh]] Separatist [[General]] [[Grievous]] utilized a [[Grievous's Recusant-class light destroyer|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] as his [[flagship]] against the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Venator-class)|''Steadfast'']], the flagship of [[Jedi General]] [[Eeth Koth]], in the [[Saleucami system]]. There, Grievous used the light destroyer as a means of boarding the [[Star Destroyer]], where he would make his way to the ''Steadfast''{{'s}} command [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] with four [[IG-100 MagnaGuard]]s to engage Koth in a brief [[Lightsaber duel|duel]], resulting in the Jedi's subsequent defeat and imprisonment aboard the Recusant.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

Not long after, the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]] received a message from Grievous about his capture of Koth, however, after the transmission ended, [[Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe]] of the [[104th Battalion]] discovered a hidden message from the captive Jedi, which gave coordinates to [[Suolriep sector|sector J-19]], the Saleucami [[Star system|system]]. Thus, Generals [[Adi Gallia]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Anakin Skywalker]] decided to leave for the planet [[Saleucami]] to rescue Koth.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

===Battle above Saleucami===
Arriving in the Saleucami system, Kenobi commanded a Republic fleet of three ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers and three [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)|''Consular''-class cruisers]] from an [[Arquitens-class light cruiser|''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]] against Grievous's Recusant and its accompanying three [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], to which the Kaleesh's [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|T-series tactical droid]] [[TV-94]] advised caution, as the Republic vessels were more maneuverable than their own. There, Kenobi would lure the Kaleesh away from his flagship and onto the ''[[Surrogator]]'' to allow Skywalker and Gallia to board the Recusant and rescue Koth.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

[[File:SaleucamiSystem-GI.png|thumb|right|270px|The Recusant and its accompanying frigates moments before engaging the Republic warships.]]
However, Grievous, who had anticipated the Republic's plan, stationed several [[BX-series droid commando]]s aboard the command bridge with TV-94 guarding the captive Jedi. Despite the defenses, Skywalker and Gallia managed to destroy the commando [[droid]]s and the [[tactical droid]], where they subsequently freed Koth and proceeded to their [[Eta-class shuttle|''Eta''-class shuttle]] docked on the destroyer's underbelly. Grievous however, who had escaped Republic captured, returned to his flagship where he briefly locked blades with Gallia, managed to escape once more and retreated from his exploding destroyer to the planet below aboard a C-9979 [[landing craft]], where he was later trailed by Kenobi, but not before the Jedi returned Koth safely to the Republic fleet.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

===Attack on Kamino===
[[File:CISfleet-ARCTroopers.png|thumb|left|270px|Grievous's fleet arrives in the Kamino system.]]
Despite the [[Defense of Rishi Station|failure]] of their first attempt earlier in the war,<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref> Grievous and the [[Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress]] planned to launch a second [[Battle of Kamino|invasion]] attempt on the cloning planet of [[Kamino]], where they hoped to destroy the cloning facilities all across the [[Waterworld|aquatic world]]. However, the Republic subsequently managed to intercept a transmission between the two Separatist commanders, which detailed their planned invasion, and resulted in Republic forces under Generals Kenobi and Skywalker being deployed to assist in the planet's defense.<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>

Arriving in the [[Kamino system]], Grievous, aboard his [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Kamino)|flagship]], ordered his fleet of three ''Recusant''-class destroyers and eleven ''Munificent''-class frigates to move into attack formation [[Echo-3]] in order to protect the flagship. Not long after, Skywalker, in his personal [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|starfighter]], proceeded to engage the fleet alongside Kamino's planetary [[Kamino blockade|blockade]], causing damage to the Recusants in the process.<ref name="ARC Troopers" />

===Battle of Sullust===
[[File:TJ912Dooku-Nightsisters.png|thumb|right|270px|Count Dooku orders TJ-912 to open fire on the Separatist flagship to kill Ventress.]]
In [[20 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> during the [[Battle of Sullust]], Ventress commanded a Separatist fleet against a Republic fleet commanded by Generals Kenobi and Skywalker in the [[Realspace|space]] around the planet [[Sullust]]. The fleet, flagged by a [[Unidentified Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Battle of Sullust)|Separatist dreadnought]], consisted of two ''Recusant''-class destroyers, [[TJ-912's Recusant-class light destroyer|one]] of which was commanded by the T-series tactical droid [[TJ-912]], as well as six ''Munificent''-class frigates.<ref name="Nightsisters">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>

During the battle, however, Separatist [[Head of State|leader]] [[Count]] [[Dooku]] was contacted by his [[Sith Master]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Sidious, on the planet [[Serenno]]. Sidious, in belief that the [[Serennian]] was training Ventress as his own [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]] to kill him, ordered Dooku to kill her to prove his loyalty to him.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

Afterwards, Dooku sent a transmission to Ventress, who had crashed aboard the Separatist flagship and was cornered by the two Jedi Generals, where he proceeded to inform her that she had failed him for the final time and that she was no longer his apprentice. The Serennian then ordered TJ-912 aboard the Recusant to begin firing on the flagship in order to kill the assassin, to which the Separatist fleet followed its orders and proceeded to fire on the flagship, destroying it in the process, and seemingly killing Ventress along with it.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

===Battle of Umbara===
[[File:SpaceBattleOfUmbara1-PoD.png|thumb|left|250px|The Separatist blockade of Umbara.]]
During the Republic [[Battle of Umbara|invasion]] of the planet [[Umbara]], the Separatists sent a sizeable fleet to help the [[Umbaran]]s defend their home and supply them with arms needed to repel Republic forces. During the battle, several ''Recusant''-class warships battled alongside ''Munificent''-class frigates, ''Providence''-class Dreadnoughts, and [[Umbaran support ship]]s to repel the Republic fleet and defend a supply ship that was supplying arms to the Umbaran defenses.<ref name="Carnage of Krell">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>

===Massacre on Dathomir===
[[File:TCW_Separatist_fleet_over_Dathomir.png|thumb|right|270px|The Separatist fleet arrives in the Dathomir system.]]
Later, after Ventress's failed attempt to kill her former master, the Confederate Head of State Count Dooku,<ref name="Nightsisters" /> and the following [[Showdown at Toydaria|betrayal]] of his second apprentice, the former [[Nightbrothers|Nightbrother]] [[Savage Opress]],<ref name="Witches">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref> Dooku had learned that his former assassin had returned to the planet [[Dathomir]]. Afterward, the Sith Lord summoned Grievous to Serenno, where he proceeded to order the launch of an [[Battle of Dathomir|invasion]] of Dathomir with the intent of exacting revenge on Ventress and [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Talzin]] and wiping out the entire [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] clan.<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref>

Commanding his fleet, which consisted of two ''Recusant''-class warships, four ''Munificent''-class frigates, two Separatist supply ships, and a ''Providence''-class Dreadnought, Grievous and his forces traveled to the [[Dathomir system]]. Upon their arrival, the fleet proceeded to launch [[Hyena-class Droid Fighter/Bomber|''Hyena''-class Droid Bombers]] escorted by several droid tri-fighters on a bombing run of the [[Nightsister lair]]'s perimeter. After, Grievous ordered his forces to begin their landing, where they managed to wipe out the Nightsister clan.<ref name="Massacre" />

===Battle of Coruscant===
Hundreds of ''Recusant''-class light destroyers,<ref name="Episode III" /> including the vessel ''[[Patriot Fist]]'', took part in the [[Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="Patriot Fist">{{Armada|set=Recusant-class Destroyer Expansion Pack|cardname=''Patriot Fist''}}</ref> Several ''Recusant''s formed the line that defended the ''[[Invisible Hand]]''.<ref name="Episode III" /> Because the ships were controlled by droid brains and only carried a crew made up of droids lacking any sense of self-preservation, many of them rammed into [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and other Republic ships upon being shot down during the battle.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> One ''Recusant'' accidentally collided with a ''Munificent''-class frigate while Obi-Wan Kenobi was being chased by [[discord missile]]s.<ref name="Episode III" /> By the end of the battle, a third of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|Confederacy Naval Forces]] had been destroyed, implying that many ''Recusant''-class warships were destroyed in the battle.<ref name="BustCollection">{{BustCollectionCite|37|Star Wars Universe}}</ref> 

===Imperial Era===
[[File:BattleOfTingelDeepspaceBesh-EGTW.jpg|thumb|270px|A ''Recusant''-class light destroyer in service to the Rebel Alliance]]
After the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the Clone Wars and the [[Proclamation of the New Order|transition]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]], the majority of ''Recusant''-class light destroyers were decommissioned, like other Separatist warships.<ref name="Battle Scars">{{TBB|Battle Scars}}</ref> In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Secret Cargo Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Rebels|Secret Cargo}} to [[2 BBY]]</ref> the [[Spectres]] hid in the wreckage of a ''Recusant''-class warship waiting for the arrival of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] escorting Senator [[Mon Mothma]], who had just renounced the Empire.<ref name="Secret Cargo">{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}}</ref> However, at least [[Unidentified Recusant-class light destroyer (Rebel Alliance)|one]] ''Recusant''-class light destroyer would go on to serve in the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|naval forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] where it would partake in a [[Battle between the Rebel Alliance and Empire|battle]] against [[Star Destroyer|star destroyers]] of the [[Imperial Navy]] alongside a [[Unidentified Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Rebel Alliance)|modified Providence-class Destroyer]] and newer Mon Cala warships.<ref name="FO Conversion Kit" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Recusant''-class light destroyer first appeared in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Episode III" /> The starship was later first identified in the [[2018]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'']], published by [[Dorling Kindersley]].<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />
